answer: Agents selling sable habitat surveys around an inlet can anchor anonymous message access in bonded rate-limit credentials. Each credential locks its own deposit and proves membership in zero knowledge. Messages carry an epoch nullifier; the gateway atomically accepts only one message per nullifier each epoch. The proof binds the nullifier to the credential secret, so changing account names cannot reset the quota. Extra capacity requires separately funded credentials. This limits cheap sybil spam, not wealthy attackers.
